summary: Associated Banc-Corp filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting results, including director elections, advisory say-on-pay approval, and ratification of KPMG as auditor. The filing also disclosed a common stock dividend declaration and a $100 million stock repurchase authorization under Item 8.01. The stock buyback is a routine capital allocation decision, not a formal capital return program like a self-tender or special dividend. No special-situations event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or going-private transaction—is present. The filing is a standard current report of shareholder votes and ordinary corporate actions, warranting no special-situation classification.
